metric_scope: Fixed linear readouts on40 whole heldout dataset episodes,12 frames each; episode-equal means
preliminary_interpretation: Current-frame spatial labels are linearly accessible from frozen CLIP. Accessibility is worse in sampled downstream representations, including the matched4096-dimensional spatial-moment comparison. Prioritize preservation/readout through the Adapter chain, without declaring information absent or a uniquely identified policy root cause.
pending: Define one controlled spatial-preservation intervention before any new policy training
limitations: Linear accessibility is not an information-theoretic presence/absence test
Different representation dimensions imply different probe capacities
The native frontend has much better policy reward but a worse angle readout than CLIP spatial moments; probe error does not rank policy competence
No policy improvement, final-set result or robot grasp success is measured
